status: accepted backend slice; D16 remains pending
scope: Add a read-only Rust platform API for checked OS storage-protection status on macOS, Windows and Linux.
behavior: macOS reports enabled or disabled only from explicit FileVault status output.
Windows inspects only the validated SystemDrive and reports enabled only when BitLocker reports both Fully Encrypted and Protection On.
Linux reports enabled only when the root source resolves to a device-mapper name and cryptsetup reports an active mapping with a non-empty cipher and positive key size.
Missing commands, unsupported platforms and inconclusive output report Unknown; command output and volume identifiers are not copied into report details.
The probe is read-only and does not change OS encryption settings.

windows.openobsidian_vault: 23 passed; Unix-only symlink test is not compiled

test_results.local_executable_validation: not run; all executable validation was through GitHub Actions

quality.attempt_1_failure: The unchanged Linux Electron vault round-trip audit did not reach its local retrieval boundary; attempt 2 passed without source changes.

repair_history.finding: Rust CI found String versus &str mismatches in failure details on all platforms and rustfmt layout changes on Ubuntu.
Rust CI found test closures retaining borrowed command arguments beyond their lifetime on all platforms; tests now capture owned strings.

limitations: This is a backend status API; it is not yet displayed in the native application UI.
Managed history and recovery directories do not yet enforce or verify user-only OS access controls.
The report checks system storage/root mapping and does not prove that every separate mounted volume is encrypted.

D16 and SYNC-007 remain Pending until the storage status is surfaced honestly in the app, recovery access controls are addressed, uninstall preservation is accepted, and legacy history workflows pass through GitHub CI.
R2.6.5 and C03/C03.2 remain in progress/Pending until full cross-layer acceptance.
next_action: Integrate Rust history and storage-protection APIs with the native application boundary, then address OS access controls for recovery data; keep D16, SYNC-007, R2.6.5 and C03/C03.2 pending until full acceptance.
